exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width, squeeze your shoulder blades together and unrack.
Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight, keeping your glutes on the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a 30–45° incline and sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Kick the dumbbells up and hold them over your upper chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest with elbows at about 45°.
Press up and slightly together without clanking the weights.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with the bar on your front shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly so it passes your face.
Finish with the bar over your mid-foot and arms locked out, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach a bar or rope to a high pulley and grip it with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down until your arms are fully straight.
Return slowly until your forearms are just above parallel, keeping your elbows still.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back until your torso is about 45° or lower, bar hanging at arm's length.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Get your chin over the bar, then lower all the way to a dead hang.
Log added weight (belt or vest) as the weight; use 0 for bodyweight.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs under the pads and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Control the bar back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet on the platform and a slight bend in the knees.
Pull the handle to your stomach, keeping your torso still.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let your arms extend fully.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at upper-chest to face height and grip it with thumbs pointing back.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating the ends beside your ears.
Pause with elbows high, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower all the way down slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and step out with feet about shoulder width apart.
Brace your core, then sit down between your hips, knees tracking over your toes.
Descend until your hip crease is at or below knee height.
Drive up through your mid-foot, keeping your chest up.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding the bar at your hips with a shoulder-width grip.
Push your hips back with a soft knee bend, sliding the bar down your thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

exercises.name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Drop your hips, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar against your legs.
Lock out with hips and knees together, then lower the bar the same way.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with feet shoulder width apart on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until your knees reach about 90°.
Press back up without locking your knees hard or lifting your hips.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes while keeping your hips down.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, shoulders under the pads.
Lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Rise up as high as possible, pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to heels by bracing your abs and glutes.
Hold for the target time without letting your hips sag.
